question: Should `appGuidedAuth` and `crestodian.setup.auth.start` become supported long-term contracts for native provider-managed sign-in?
rationale: The PR intentionally expands public plugin metadata and gateway protocol surfaces across bundled and external providers, CLI clients, and native applications; implementation repair cannot determine that permanent product/API commitment.

options.title: Adopt the generic contract
options.body: Keep the plugin-owned design, repair and document the contract, and require representative real setup proof before merge.

options.title: Keep provider sign-in CLI-only
options.body: Remove the native app-guided capability and retain the existing provider CLI and key-based onboarding paths.

recommendation.title: Adopt the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the plugin-owned design, repair and document the contract, and require representative real setup proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history shows the strongest ownership across the affected onboarding, provider-runtime, and plugin-contract surfaces.
